name: Practiced Flyer
body:
You have spent many hours practicing your flying, growing faster as a result.

Prerequisite: Skill Focus (Fly)

Benefit: Your speed when flying increases by 1 for every rank of the Fly skill you possess. In combat, all speeds must be in multiples of 5 and thus, in combat, a fly speed of 34 feet is no different than a fly speed of 30 feet.
